desc: Taylor's long gun product line has a rifle for every kind of shooting you want to do. The 1873 Model became an immediate favorite among civilians and international military. It was the first lever-action to help meet all types of shooters' needs. This Sporting model features a 20" full octagon barrel, blued finish with case hardened frame, walnut stock with checkered pistol grip, and blade front with Buckhorn rear sights.
